summary: The authors’ Table S2 answers the registered 27-versus-6-month contrast in male rat hypothalamus. All 43 source files passed integrity checks. Independent recomputation reproduced 613 of 817 selected genes paired (75.03%), Pearson 0.9325, Spearman 0.9264 and agreement in 604 of 612 nonzero pairs. The proposal correctly records a limited comparison.
openIssues: Coverage falls below the 90% requirement. The complete author endpoint table and unrounded statistics remain unavailable in the reviewed sources.
The registered analysis includes one 27-month rat, GSM9417680, that the authors excluded during quality control.
